Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.widgets

package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.widgets
Reusable widget primitives for the Juneau REST server toolkit.

This optional module holds the shared Widget marker and the bean-only definitions for the reusable calendar widget (CalendarDef, EventCategory, CalendarEvent). Table-specific types (row actions, bulk mutate) stay in juneau-rest-server-views; this module has no dependency on views, so a widget bean can never import a views-module type. A CalendarDef carries no HTML-emitter code — pages mount an empty data-juneau-calendar marker and juneau-calendar.js hydrates it.
